description: Implementation of the BufferPool class for managing GPU buffers in Metal renderer within ANGLE project.

classes.name: BufferPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of GPU buffers for efficient memory allocation and reuse in Metal renderer.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the buffer pool with specified size, alignment, and maximum buffers.

methods.name: allocateNewBuffer
methods.description: Allocates a new GPU buffer, reusing free buffers if possible.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates a memory region within the buffer pool, possibly creating a new buffer.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Finalizes current buffer allocations, unmaps buffers, and tracks in-flight buffers.

methods.name: releaseInFlightBuffers
methods.description: Releases buffers that have finished GPU usage, moving them to free list.

methods.name: destroyBufferList
methods.description: Clears a list of buffers and updates allocation count.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys all buffers and resets the pool.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal state of the buffer pool.
